data.value: Will Mayor Elena Vasquez sign the city budget before the October 1 fiscal year deadline?

The city council of Oakwood passed a revised budget on September 14, which now awaits the mayor's signature. The fiscal year begins October 1. The mayor has threatened a veto unless the council restores funding for the library.
